terrains.name: Road
terrains.description: Normal movement. No protection.

terrains.name: Plains
terrains.description: Normal movement. No protection.

terrains.name: Forest
terrains.description: Costs 2 movement; ranged damage reduced by 1.

terrains.name: Hills
terrains.description: Costs 2 movement; all damage reduced by 1.

terrains.name: Water
terrains.description: Impassable to land units.

terrains.name: Bridge
terrains.description: A crossing over water. Normal movement; no protection.

terrains.name: Shallow water
terrains.description: Costs 3 movement for soldiers and commanders, 2 for archers and scouts. Units here take 1 extra damage.

terrains.name: Village
terrains.description: +2 gold per turn. Heals a friendly occupant by 4 HP.

terrains.name: Keep
terrains.description: Your commander can recruit into adjacent empty hexes. Blocks ranged attacks through the tile.

terrains.name: Marsh
terrains.description: Mud slows land units and exposes them to 1 extra damage. Merfolk move easily here and take 1 less damage.

terrains.name: Ruins
terrains.description: Broken walls reduce ranged damage by 1 without blocking shots through the tile. Some campaign ruins contain binding stones; their objectives specify who can seal them.

terrains.name: Fort
terrains.description: Earthworks reduce all incoming damage by 1. Capture by entering; forts provide no income or healing.

terrains.name: Sacred grove
terrains.description: Trees reduce ranged damage by 1 and block shots through the tile. An owned grove heals its friendly occupant by 4 HP, but provides no income.

terrains.name: Ferry landing
terrains.description: A jetty on the riverbank. Normal movement; no protection.

terrains.name: Moored ferry
terrains.description: A boat moored beside a riverbank jetty. Normal movement; no protection. Boarding does not move units across the river.

terrains.name: House
terrains.description: A single home. Normal movement; no protection, income or healing.

terrains.name: Mountains
terrains.description: A sheer mountain ridge, impassable to land units. Blocks ranged attacks through the tile.

terrains.name: Quarry cave
terrains.description: A sheltered entrance at the foot of a mountain. Costs 2 movement; no protection. The mountain blocks ranged attacks through the tile. Scenario objectives specify what can be found inside.

terrains.name: Burned village
terrains.description: Charred homes on open ground. No income, healing or protection.

terrains.name: Road sign
terrains.description: A wooden waymarker beside the road. Normal movement; no protection.

terrains.name: Castle courtyard
terrains.description: Paved fortifications. Normal movement; all incoming damage reduced by 1. No income, healing or recruitment.

terrains.name: Bell keep
terrains.description: An enclosed fortified keep. Its owner’s leader can recruit into adjacent empty passable hexes. All incoming damage reduced by 1. No income or healing.

terrains.name: Hill monastery
terrains.description: A hilltop sanctuary. Costs 1 movement and shelters against ranged attacks. Scenario rituals use this site.

terrains.name: Church
terrains.description: A quiet church. Normal movement; no protection. Scenario discoveries may leave equipment here.

terrains.name: Burial ground
terrains.description: Old burial stones. Normal movement; no protection.

terrains.name: Ritual mark
terrains.description: A charged ritual mark. Captives still standing here can be consumed by the bell.

terrains.name: Spent ritual mark
terrains.description: The ritual has burned out. It cannot feed the bell again.
